Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 1995
ACT I OF 1995
PROVINCIAL MOTOR VEHICLES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995
An Act further to amend the
Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 8th March, 1995]
No. PAB/Legis.V(16)/94, dated
8-3-1995.--The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Bill, 1995 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 15th February, 1995 and
assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Assembly.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 1995.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment in the Sixth Schedule of W.P. Ordinance XIX of 1965

ACT I OF 1995
ACT I OF 1995
PROVINCIAL MOTOR VEHICLES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995
An Act further to amend the
Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 8th March, 1995]
No. PAB/Legis.V(16)/94, dated
8-3-1995.--The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Bill, 1995 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 15th February, 1995 and
assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Assembly.
2. Amendment in the Sixth Schedule of W.P. Ordinance XIX of 1965.- In
the first and second column of the Sixth Schedule to the Provincial Motor
Vehicles Ordinance, 1965.
(a) for the word and letters
"Kachhi... KI", the words and letters "Jhal Magsi .....Jhal
Magsi" shall be substituted.
(b) for the word and letters
"Tamboo ... ...TU", the words and letters "Nasirabad ...
...ND" shall be substituted;
(c) for the word and letters
"Turbat ... ...TT", the word and letters "Kech ... ...KC"
shall be substituted.
(d) after the word and letters
"Nasirabad .... ...ND", as so substituted, the following new words
and letters shall be added, namely:--
"Bolan
.... BLN
Mastung
.... MG
Awaran
....AN
Killa Abdullah
.KA

Repeal

3. Repeal.--The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance,
1994 (VIII of 1994), is hereby repealed.
